source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of incomplete dominance; the book's problem is a self-check with a drawn Punnett square (PDF 90-91).

blocks.text: Incomplete dominance mein koi bhi allele doosre par poori tarah dominant nahi hota. Aisi soorat mein heterozygous fard ka phenotype dono walidain ke phenotypes ke darmiyan (intermediate) hota hai. Misaal: Japani four-o’clock paudon mein jab surkh phool wale (RR) ko safaid phool wale (WW) se milaya jata hai to sab bachche heterozygous gulabi phool wale (RW) hote hain. Is se pata chalta hai ke na surkh ka allele (R) aur na safaid ka allele (W) poori tarah dominant hai. Jab do gulabi paudon (RW × RW) ka cross kiya jaye to surkh (RR), gulabi (RW) aur safaid (WW) 1:2:1 ratio mein aate hain.

blocks.alt: Four-o'clock ke phool. Walidain: surkh phool (RR) x safaid phool (WW); gametes R, R aur W, W; teer chaar gulabi F1 paudon tak jate hain, genotypes RW, phenotype sab gulabi. F1 x F1: do gulabi phool; gametes R, W aur R, W; teer chaar F2 paudon tak: aik surkh, do gulabi, aik safaid.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.3: Japani 4-o'clock paudon mein incomplete dominance (kitab ki Figure 18.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Parents, Red, White, Gametes, F1 plants, Genotypes RW, Phenotypes All Pink, F1 X F1, F2 plants, Genotypes RR, RW, RW, WW, Phenotypes 1: Red, 2: Pink, 1: White.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teer dekhein: har F2 paude ko aik gamete aik gulabi walid se aur aik doosre gulabi walid se milta hai. R + R = surkh (RR), R + W = gulabi (RW, do baar), W + W = safaid (WW). Incomplete dominance mein phenotype ki ratio (1:2:1) aur genotype ki ratio (1:2:1) aik jaisi hoti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 18.3 mein F2 ke chaaron paudon ke neeche genotype 'RW' chhapa hai, halanke phenotypes 1 surkh : 2 gulabi : 1 safaid likhe hain. Sahi genotypes RR (surkh), RW aur RW (gulabi) aur WW (safaid) hain, jaisa hamare khaake mein hai.
Gulabi phool wala four-o’clock paudha surkh phool wale paude se milaya jata hai. Maloom karein:

items: (a) Surkh phool wale paude ki probability
(b) Gulabi phool wale paude ki probability
(c) Gulabi aur surkh phool wale paudon ki ratio

blocks.prompt: Gulabi (RW) × surkh (RR) cross ka Punnett square banayein aur (a) surkh, (b) gulabi ki probability aur (c) gulabi : surkh ratio nikalein.
blocks.explanation: Surkh walid (RR) sirf R gametes deta hai; gulabi walid (RW) R ya W barabar deta hai. Punnett square ke chaar khanon mein 2 RR aur 2 RW aate hain. (a) Surkh (RR) = 2/4 = 1/2. (b) Gulabi (RW) = 2/4 = 1/2. (c) Gulabi : surkh = 1 : 1. Safaid (WW) koi nahi, kyunke surkh walid W deta hi nahi.

answer_figure.alt: Punnett square: oopar surkh walid (RR) ke gametes R aur R, baen taraf gulabi walid (RW) ke gametes R aur W. Oopar ki qatar mein RR surkh, RR surkh; neeche ki qatar mein RW gulabi, RW gulabi. Neeche likha hai: surkh 1/2, gulabi 1/2, gulabi : surkh = 1 : 1.
answer_figure.caption: Jawab ka diagram (pehle khud banayein, phir milayein): gulabi (RW) × surkh (RR) ka Punnett square
answer_figure.long_description: Oopar 'Pink flower (RW) × Red flower (RR)' likha hai. Grid ke oopar surkh walid ke do gametes R, R aur baen taraf gulabi walid ke gametes R, W gol daairon mein hain. Chaar khane: R+R = RR (Red), R+R = RR (Red), W+R = RW (Pink), W+R = RW (Pink). Neeche jawab: (a) Red (RR) = 2/4 = 1/2, (b) Pink (RW) = 2/4 = 1/2, (c) Pink : Red = 1 : 1.

items: Incomplete dominance: heterozygote darmiyani phenotype dikhata hai (RW gulabi).
RR × WW: sab RW gulabi; RW × RW: 1 surkh : 2 gulabi : 1 safaid.
